Is the following answer to question correct? If not could you please explain the mistakes and answer the question according to shariah with refrence. Q: If the pant's hems are at ankles(below the ankles) can they be folded before performing Namaz? A: If pant's bottoms are at ankle it is not allowed to fold them to perform namaz, perform the Namaz without folding them. If pant's hems are kept below ankles because of pride, it is HARAM, in this case Namaz will be Makrooh-e-Tehreemi (Wajib to repeat Namaz) otherwise it's only Makrooh-e-Tanzeehi which is Khilafe Aula in Namaz. Same is written in Fatawa-e-Rizvia in part three on page 448. In case of folding the pants hems in Namaz will definitely be Makrooh-e-Tehreemi which will make it Wajib to perform the Namaz again. It's in Hadees *. Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihe Wasslam said:" I was ordered that not to fold hair and cloth (In Namaz)" ted in Darr-e-Mukhtar with Shami Part one page 473. art one, Page 137)-Allah Ta'ala Knows the best. 5161 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 10752 Country: AU Title: Salaam my question is is the shaving Haram? if its haram can you give me prove from Hadith? and how long we have to have wsalaam Question: Salaam my question is is the shaving Haram? if its haram can you give me prove from Hadith? and how long we have to have wsalaam Answer ID: 10752 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 263/239=D/1430) It is haram to shave beard. It is narrated in many hadith: احفوا الشوارب واعفوا اللحی (trim the moustache and grow beard). The imperative sentence suggests that it is wajib (essential). Therefore, shaving beard is haram . The beard at least should be one fist in length: کما في الدر المختار: ولذا یحرم علی الرجل قطع لحیتہ وقال الشامي تحتہ وھو أن یقبض الرجل لحیتہ فما زاد منھا علی قبضۃ قطعہ (رد المحتار مع الدر المختار 9:583) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
